spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.subtitle: Spaces are class or group rooms where you can share assignments with students, either with the whole class or with a smaller group.

trainingVideo.description: See how to create and share spaces
trainingVideo.title: Guide: spaces

filters.label: Filters
filters.showClosedTitle: Turn on to show both open and closed spaces

access.title: Spaces are for teachers
access.subtitle: Sign in with a teacher account to create and manage your own rooms. Students join by code or link.

guestPreview.title: Want to create a Space?
guestPreview.subtitle: As a guest, you can see how Spaces work. Sign in when you want to create rooms, invite students and save your work.
guestPreview.body: Spaces bring your class, assignments, board activities and submissions together in one place. Creating a Space is free. Students can join with a code or QR, also anonymously.
guestPreview.loginCreate: Sign in to create a Space
guestPreview.lockedText: You can explore the flow here, but you need to be signed in as a teacher to create rooms and invite students.

organize.title: Organize the class
organize.text: Create rooms for a class, group or course, and keep tasks and activity together.

share.title: Share with code
share.text: Students can join with a class code, link or QR code on their own device.

follow.title: Follow the work
follow.text: See who has started, submitted and needs follow-up from the teacher.
